name: saucedemo-automation-portfolio-cypress
description: Automação front-end do Swag Labs com Cypress + Cucumber

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const dir of ['allure-results', 'allure-report', 'reports', 'cypress/screenshots']) require('fs').rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test: npm run clean && cypress run --browser chrome
scripts.test:smoke: npm run clean && cypress run --browser chrome --expose tags=@smoke
scripts.test:defeitos: npm run clean && cypress run --browser chrome --expose tags=@defeito
scripts.test:nao-funcionais: npm run clean && cypress run --browser chrome --expose "tags=@performance or @seguranca"
